fields.Name: IT100 - Realtime Session Identity Verification
fields.Description: Client-transport bundle, sequence 50, run after IT99. Drives mid-session identity verification over the GraphQL wire through GraphQLRealtimeSessionClient and a real HTTP GET and POST of the public /realtime/verify route. Covers the link and typed-code paths, identity.verified observed on the RealtimeSessionEvents subscription, deadline extension, single use, hashed-at-rest secrets, the owner's forging attempts refused over the wire, the policy snapshot, and uniform refusal of non-owner access. Needs MJAPI with realtime.identityVerification enabled and deliveryMode dry-run, so the emailed link and code can be read from the Communication Log. Requires RUN_MUTATION_TESTS because every check writes.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The link and code paths verify once and only once; identity.verified reaches only its own session; secrets are never recoverable from the session row; forged state is refused over the wire; refusals are indistinguishable.
